{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"公司以构建“大产业链”思路推动产能互融、多能互补、煤气电联动，形成产、购、销、储、运、用的综合能源产业链，业务涵盖绿色低碳综合智慧能源、节能、环保、能源金融等投资开发和经营。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"公司火力发电厂集中在粤港澳大湾区电力负荷中心，是华南地区大型发电企业之一；风力及光伏发电等新能源项目已覆盖全国20个省市。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F03","text":"全资子公司燃气集团是广州市城市燃气高压管网建设和天然气购销的主体，统筹全市高压管网建设和上游气源采购、下游天然气输配及分销。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F04","text":"全资子公司能源物流集团是华南地区最大的纵向一体化煤炭经营企业，拥有67万立方米大型油库及配套8万吨级石油化工专业码头，是甲醇、生物质油料重要集散基地。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F05","text":"储能集团在源网荷侧全面布局，已搭建一体化储能电站运维云平台，推动本地储能产业集群化发展。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F06","text":"公司为广大客户提供电力、煤炭、天然气、蒸汽、成品油等能源产品和能源管理服务，同时提供天然气、煤炭和油品装卸、运输和储存服务；金融业务主要为能源产业发展提供金融支持。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F07","text":"公司电力、蒸汽主要通过所属火力发电机组、风力和光伏发电设备生产；火力发电涵盖燃煤发电、燃气发电、热电联产、分布式能源站，并拓展售电、配电网、能源检修与技术服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F08","text":"公司依托涵盖电力、燃气、能源物流、新能源、储能等多元化的综合能源体系，提供源网荷储充一体化、能源托管、节能运维、碳资产管理等一体化服务，构建“投资-建设-运营-增值服务”全链条服务模式。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F09","text":"公司电力主要通过国家电网、南方电网销售给终端用户，积极推进发售电一体运营模式；天然气、煤炭、成品油、蒸汽等通过自有管网、销售平台及运输、批发、销售一体化的产业链等销售给终端用户。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F10","text":"公司天然气、煤炭和成品油等通过外部采购，与国内外知名供应商建立长期战略合作关系以控制采购成本。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F11","text":"公司2025年实现营业总收入508.83亿元，同比增加5.29%；实现利润总额30.51亿元、归属于母公司的净利润23.19亿元，同比增加27.96%和33.93%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业总收入","raw_value":"508.83","value":"508.83","unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业总收入同比","raw_value":"5.29","value":"5.29","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"利润总额","raw_value":"30.51","value":"30.51","unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于母公司的净利润","raw_value":"23.19","value":"23.19","unit":"亿元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于母公司的净利润同比","raw_value":"33.93","value":"33.93","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F12","text":"按主营业务分行业口径，能源物流业务营业收入294.85亿元、毛利率1.10%；天然气业务营业收入105.02亿元、毛利率13.66%；燃煤发电及供热业务营业收入43.50亿元、毛利率14.21%；天然气发电及供热业务营业收入32.05亿元、毛利率13.45%；新能源及储能业务营业收入32.46亿元、毛利率49.30%；其他产业营业收入0.96亿元、毛利率78.02%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0011","source-0012"],"metrics":[{"name":"能源物流业务营业收入","raw_value":"29,485,020,343.45","value":"29485020343.45","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"能源物流业务毛利率","raw_value":"1.10","value":"1.10","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气业务营业收入","raw_value":"10,502,056,882.42","value":"10502056882.42","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气业务毛利率","raw_value":"13.66","value":"13.66","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电及供热业务营业收入","raw_value":"4,349,947,127.70","value":"4349947127.70","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电及供热业务毛利率","raw_value":"14.21","value":"14.21","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电及供热业务营业收入","raw_value":"3,204,831,500.79","value":"3204831500.79","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电及供热业务毛利率","raw_value":"13.45","value":"13.45","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源及储能业务营业收入","raw_value":"3,245,504,723.82","value":"3245504723.82","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新能源及储能业务毛利率","raw_value":"49.30","value":"49.30","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他产业营业收入","raw_value":"95,784,921.17","value":"95784921.17","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他产业毛利率","raw_value":"78.02","value":"78.02","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F13","text":"按主营业务分产品口径，煤炭营业收入230.65亿元、毛利率1.29%；天然气营业收入105.02亿元、毛利率13.66%；油品营业收入63.96亿元、毛利率0.22%；燃煤发电营业收入39.92亿元、毛利率13.81%；天然气发电营业收入30.09亿元、毛利率14.13%；风力发电营业收入21.95亿元、毛利率52.48%；光伏发电营业收入10.21亿元、毛利率43.45%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012"],"metrics":[{"name":"煤炭营业收入","raw_value":"23,064,543,028.53","value":"23064543028.53","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"煤炭毛利率","raw_value":"1.29","value":"1.29","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气营业收入","raw_value":"10,502,056,882.42","value":"10502056882.42","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气毛利率","raw_value":"13.66","value":"13.66","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"油品营业收入","raw_value":"6,395,908,933.37","value":"6395908933.37","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"油品毛利率","raw_value":"0.22","value":"0.22","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电营业收入","raw_value":"3,991,623,307.63","value":"3991623307.63","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电毛利率","raw_value":"13.81","value":"13.81","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电营业收入","raw_value":"3,009,223,900.18","value":"3009223900.18","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电毛利率","raw_value":"14.13","value":"14.13","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"风力发电营业收入","raw_value":"2,194,507,260.36","value":"2194507260.36","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"风力发电毛利率","raw_value":"52.48","value":"52.48","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"光伏发电营业收入","raw_value":"1,020,539,666.84","value":"1020539666.84","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"光伏发电毛利率","raw_value":"43.45","value":"43.45","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F14","text":"按主营业务分地区口径，华南地区营业收入284.90亿元、毛利率8.82%；其他地区营业收入223.94亿元、毛利率8.81%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012"],"metrics":[{"name":"华南地区营业收入","raw_value":"28,489,632,478.05","value":"28489632478.05","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华南地区毛利率","raw_value":"8.82","value":"8.82","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他地区营业收入","raw_value":"22,393,513,021.30","value":"22393513021.30","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他地区毛利率","raw_value":"8.81","value":"8.81","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F15","text":"截至2025年12月31日，公司发电装机容量达到1,097万千瓦，其中火力发电可控装机容量为484万千瓦，风力及光伏发电可控装机容量为613万千瓦，绿色低碳能源装机占比超77%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"截至2025年12月31日","evidence_ids":["source-0001"],"metrics":[{"name":"发电装机容量","raw_value":"1,097","value":"1097","unit":"万千瓦","currency":null,"period":"截至2025年12月31日","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"火力发电可控装机容量","raw_value":"484","value":"484","unit":"万千瓦","currency":null,"period":"截至2025年12月31日","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"风力及光伏发电可控装机容量","raw_value":"613","value":"613","unit":"万千瓦","currency":null,"period":"截至2025年12月31日","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"绿色低碳能源装机占比","raw_value":"超77","value":"77","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"截至2025年12月31日","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"greater_than"}]},{"fact_id":"F16","text":"2025年公司电力生产量243.76亿千瓦时、销售量233.89亿千瓦时；热力生产量682.58万吉焦、销售量684.66万吉焦；市场煤销售量4,801.25万吨；成品油销售量100.37万吨；天然气销售量359,796.93万立方米。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0012"],"metrics":[{"name":"电力生产量","raw_value":"243.76","value":"243.76","unit":"亿千瓦时","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"电力销售量","raw_value":"233.89","value":"233.89","unit":"亿千瓦时","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"热力生产量","raw_value":"682.58","value":"682.58","unit":"万吉焦","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"热力销售量","raw_value":"684.66","value":"684.66","unit":"万吉焦","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"市场煤销售量","raw_value":"4,801.25","value":"4801.25","unit":"万吨","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"成品油销售量","raw_value":"100.37","value":"100.37","unit":"万吨","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气销售量","raw_value":"359,796.93","value":"359796.93","unit":"万立方米","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F17","text":"2025年公司市场化交易总电量1,821,650万千瓦时，占总上网电量2,303,657万千瓦时的79.08%，占比较上年增加1.41个百分点。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0023"],"metrics":[{"name":"市场化交易总电量","raw_value":"1,821,650","value":"1821650","unit":"万千瓦时","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"总上网电量","raw_value":"2,303,657","value":"2303657","unit":"万千瓦时","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"市场化交易电量占比","raw_value":"79.08","value":"79.08","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"市场化交易电量占比同比变动","raw_value":"1.41","value":"1.41","unit":"百分点","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact","source_unit":"%"}]}]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F18","text":"公司天然气、煤炭和成品油等通过外部采购；成本构成中，能源物流业务的煤炭供应链成本227.26亿元、外购油品63.23亿元，天然气业务的外购燃气75.91亿元，燃煤发电及供热业务的燃料成本29.12亿元，天然气发电及供热业务的燃料成本21.49亿元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0013"],"metrics":[{"name":"煤炭供应链成本","raw_value":"22,726,364,423.78","value":"22726364423.78","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"外购油品成本","raw_value":"6,323,377,466.53","value":"6323377466.53","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"外购燃气成本","raw_value":"7,591,261,336.43","value":"7591261336.43","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"燃煤发电及供热燃料成本","raw_value":"2,912,103,112.91","value":"2912103112.91","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"天然气发电及供热燃料成本","raw_value":"2,148,623,621.18","value":"2148623621.18","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"business_segment","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F19","text":"公司2025年资本性支出775,182万元，其中新扩建项目支出639,835万元、股权投资与项目前期费用支出84,498万元、技改项目支出37,039万元、固定/无形资产购置支出12,139万元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0021"],"metrics":[{"name":"资本性支出","raw_value":"775,182","value":"775182","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"新扩建项目支出","raw_value":"639,835","value":"639835","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"股权投资与项目前期费用支出","raw_value":"84,498","value":"84498","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"技改项目支出","raw_value":"37,039","value":"37039","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"固定/无形资产购置支出","raw_value":"12,139","value":"12139","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F20","text":"公司2025年研发投入合计6.48亿元，全部费用化，研发投入总额占营业收入比例1.27%；研发人员1,069人，占公司总人数的16.73%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0017"],"metrics":[{"name":"研发投入合计","raw_value":"647,912,418.52","value":"647912418.52","unit":"元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"研发投入总额占营业收入比例","raw_value":"1.27","value":"1.27","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"研发人员数量","raw_value":"1,069","value":"1069","unit":"人","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"研发人员数量占公司总人数比例","raw_value":"16.73","value":"16.73","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F21","text":"公司深耕华南，服务粤港澳大湾区，业务拓展到国内26个省市，外延至11个国家和地区。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0001"]},{"fact_id":"F22","text":"2025年公司前五名客户销售额1,630,937.15万元，占年度销售总额32.08%，其中关联方销售额0万元；前五名供应商采购额787,537.73万元，占年度采购总额16.97%，其中关联方采购额146,943.11万元，占年度采购总额3.17%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0015"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名客户销售额","raw_value":"1,630,937.15","value":"1630937.15","unit":"万元","currency":"人民币","period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五名客户销售额占年度销售总额比例","raw_value":"32.08","value":"32.08","unit":"%","currency":null,"period":"2025年度","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五名供应商采购额","raw_value":"787,537.73","value
